titulo: Former Bachelor star Sam Wood charged with domestic violence
cuerpo: Police arrested 46-year-old in Noosa and charged him with assault occasioning bodily harm and strangulation in a domestic setting Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The fitness influencer and reality TV star Sam Wood has been charged in Queensland with domestic violence offences. The personal trainer and star of the third season of the Australian version of the reality TV show The Bachelor was charged on Sunday and spent the weekend in police custody after an alleged incident on Saturday night.
